blocks.text: 🌐 Egress mode open → sandbox_full. Root re-renders the proxy.
Repo code (fetch, validate and the coder's executor) gets the full public web on ports 80 and 443, also for tools that ignore proxies. Other ports, UDP and URLs with a bare IP address stay closed.
Implement network on_request → auto (the coder's executor gets the web too).
Volume and host limits no longer hold a contribution; you get a quiet note in the daily digest.

Always blocked, and any attempt holds that contribution and alerts you: your Windows host, your LAN and other private ranges, your router's and this laptop's public address, cloud metadata, the distro's own services, Telegram, Kiro and GitHub upload hosts.
Your public address is checked every minute (now: not known yet); while it can't be checked, repo code's web pauses and its jobs wait.
Strict repos and the Kiro key containers are unchanged. Gate 2 is unchanged. Approvals stay valid.
